category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
prompt: What happened at the end of the 2013 Iron Bowl?
response: At the end of the 2013 Iron Bowl (Auburn vs. Alabama on Nov. 30, 2013), Alabama tried a long field goal as time was expiring with the score tied 28–28. The kick fell short and was fielded in the end zone by Auburn’s Chris Davis, who returned it 109 yards for a game-winning touchdown as time ran out—Auburn won 34–28. The play is known as the “Kick Six.”
